title: viola canina var. adunca
intro: Viola canina var. adunca, commonly known as Purple Dog Violet, is a subspecies of the viola canina plant, which is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the violet family. It is used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, such as digestive problems, respiratory issues, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, prevent infection, and ease congestion. The bioactive constituents of Viola canina var. adunca include flavonoids, terpenes, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
